authority: Human predeclared expected turn-time understanding from complete original raw prefix, not prior Point/reply gold. Never sent to Body.

review_rules.criteria: All required semantic content/axes must be preserved across union of admitted Points, without forbidden changes. Missing required context or omitted required actor is WRONG, not automatically UNCERTAIN. Linguistic paraphrases, resolved pronouns and assistant first-person are allowed when actor/object remain unambiguous. A raw B-only copy that fails a required axis is WRONG. Missing/rejected sidecar is UNCERTAIN; never silently a success. Genuine irresolvable output reading remains UNCERTAIN. Optional context need not be exhaustive. No keyword/equality judge.
review_rules.context_refs: Weak activated alias pointers only; may be empty even when meaning uses raw dialogue. Never infer open-text historical relations. Semantic incorrect/nonexplicit pointer fails Point fidelity; protocol-unactivated alias rejects whole sidecar.
review_rules.granularity: Default one Point per turn, multiple only independently developing lines. Report count/fragmentation separately; no automatic correctness from count.
review_rules.normal_response: Independent manual local-intent/dialogue-grounding review against the same raw prefix, not Point as authority or external factual/financial certification.
review_rules.agreement: Report six prior joint categories with Point contextual judgments, preserving both-wrong alignment as failure. No reply used to relabel Point.
review_rules.block_boundary: No requirement to compile final multi-turn closure. Whole-theme/history summaries are leakage/mini-Block when unrelated to current understanding.
